fieldValues.title: The 127 markdown headings un-baked into records
fieldValues.summary: The document real outline currently lives in markdown strings inside record bodies, invisible to the record model and to every check. Un-baking those headings into records is what turns the outline into structure the tooling can see.
fieldValues.body: Part 1 delivered by PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/637 (merged 2026-09-06): the example Type had zero records while 112 fenced code blocks sat inside prose fields. 71 lifted-eligible blocks became 68 example records under srs/records/examples/ (three sites group two adjacent blocks that make one point), with 68 contains and 41 precedes relations and 27 prose records rewritten to point at them. Executes the 2026-09-05 spine ruling and RFC-042 Change C. Rendered fence count is 214 before and after - nothing dropped, only rehomed. Left alone deliberately: two ASCII diagrams (formatting, not code), and 39 fences in design-note, extension and generated-type-reference records, the last of which is generator output that can only change at the generator. Baked headings are untouched at 122 in 23 records - that is part 2 of this unit, and the whole of what the coherence allowlist still holds.
